name: agent-judgement
description: Guided decision making: frame the question, write down where you lean, widen the options, weigh them one thing at a time, test the favourite, commit with a forecast, and come back to learn. Plain files, no runtime.

interface.shortDescription: Make a decision well, and learn from how it turns out.
interface.longDescription: A guide for decisions that matter. It works through seven stages with you, keeps one plain JSON record, and draws an illustrated board you can open in any browser.
defaultPrompt: Help me decide something that matters.
Look back at a decision we made.
Show me the board for this decision.
